sloka: सदानृणमिमं रामं वयमिच्छामहे पितु: ।अनृणत्वाच्च कैकेय्या: स्वर्गं दशरथो गत: ॥ २.११२.६॥
transliteration: sadānṛṇamimaṁ rāmaṁ vayamicchāmahe pitu: ।anṛṇatvācca kaikeyyā: svargaṁ daśaratho gata: ॥ 2.112.6॥

translations.english: We always desire that Rama should discharge his debt to his father. Dasaratha, who by redeeming himself of his obligation to Kaikeyi, had ascended heaven.
